code_provenance.note: Request phases isolate deployment resource changes; final backup transport was additionally verified against a rebuilt real image.

backup_idle_timing.note: Separate low-load snapshot with a bounded builder on the same two-CPU VM; cgroup peak includes charged page cache.

disk.note: Database and image size fields reflect the baseline runtime; rebuilt image recovery and registry data are reported separately.

limits: Native ARM64; Linux AMD64 was not emulated or benchmarked.
One-CPU cgroup quota is a proxy, not a reproduction of Yandex Cloud CPU scheduling or hardware.
OS, Docker daemon, sampler and external SMTP/S3 emulators are outside the application parent CPU quota.
Cloud network HDD/SSD latency and throughput were not reproduced.
20% CPU, RAM below 4 GiB, long-term peak traffic and future migrations were not validated.
S3 version deletion and rule configuration passed on HTTPS Moto; the Yandex lifecycle scheduler was not executed.

one_command_replay.note: One CLI invocation with the rebuilt backup retry image. Reused synthetic dataset; startup/indexing are not cold-start measurements. Original matrix above remains unchanged.
one_command_replay.backup_memory_note: RSS about 54 MiB; cgroup lifetime peak about 256 MiB including charged file cache. Working set peaked at 97.4 MiB during background load; no OOM. The previous idle one-off peak does not bound a reused worker lifetime.
